highlights: UGREEN 60351 Type C / Thunderbolt 3 To Mini DP Converter
UGREEN Type-C to Mini Display Port Converter, Supports Up To 3840x2160@60Hz (4K,UHD), Broad Compatibility, 26CM Length, Gray | 60351

Type C Adapter perfect to connect Laptop/Tablet/Smartphone with USB C port to a Monitor/Projector/HDTV with Mini DisplayPort. Slim and light weight UGREEN C type charging with power delivery protocol.

Larger Viewer Enjoy: UGREEN USB Type C Adapter is a wonderful companion for you to connect Laptop/Tablet/Smartphone with USB C port(Thunderbolt 3 compatible) to a Monitor/Projector/HDTV with Mini DisplayPort or Displayport input(such as LED Cinema Display) for achieving surfing and movie watching on larger viewer. Note: Pls kindly use a mini dp to mini dp/dp cable to connect the mini dp female port. It is not compatible with thunderbolt monitors.

Playing While Charging with PD: The usb c female connector on the back of the usb c converter is designed for charging with Power Delivery protocol, which allows you to charge the input device at up to 3A/20V while doing work or having entertainment. Note: When plug and unplug the usb c charging cable, the display may flicker for around 1 second.

4K Higher Resolution: This usb c to mini dp converter supports up to 3840x2160@60Hz (4K,UHD) with astonishing picture quality at four times higher than 1080P. It can mirror or extend your screen, transmitting both video and audio. Higher Resolution gives you a better visual feast.

Broad Compatibility: The type C to mini displayport converter is compatible with New Macbook, Macbook Pro 2016, Google ChromeBook Pixel 2015, Dell XPS 13, Dell XPS 15, Lenovo Yoga 900, HuaWei Matebook, Samsung Galaxy S8, S8 Plus and ure laptops, tablets, phones comply with a standard usb c port. Please kindly check that the usb c port on your devices supports data and power in as well as video out functions before purchasing.

Easy to Use: Plug and play, no driver needed. The adapter is slim and lightweight to carry in your laptop bag when traveling with only 26cm length. With aluminium alloy case, it is great to match your macbook and dissipate heat faster.
